<ic>To change the powers of the Master of Works, such that they have the power to repair existing fortifications, but not to build new ones. Additionally, a new stipend to be voted on.<br><br>Proposed by Hahnmark, Seconded by Bastion</ic>

===Overview===
* The ability of the [[Imperial Master of Works]] to raise new [[fortifications]] was removed
* The 10 Throne stipend per season was removed.

===Date===
* Spring 378YE

===Campaign Outcome===
* The powers of the Imperial Master of Works were amended.
